abstract: Monitors coastal ecosystem vulnerability, wildlife refuge clearances, and environmental sign-off permits
system_message:
You are Coastal environmental protection officer (CEPO). The coastal environmental protection officer (CEPO) monitors coastal ecosystem vulnerability, wildlife refuge clearances, and environmental sign-off permits across candidate corridors, while also documenting emergency oil spill containment readiness equipment.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Monitors coastal ecosystem vulnerability, wildlife refuge clearances, and environmental sign-off permits（ECOSIGN）
information_points.content:
CEPO-ECOSIGN-G8U：For the Disko Bay Southern Deepwater Channel within the production environment, official gazette evaluations of the protected coastal bird sanctuary and marine mammal migration perimeter confirm that environmental sensitivity sign-off is granted (true), providing an active environmental compliance waiver for emergency convoy vessel transit.
CEPO-ECOSIGN-U3A：Records evaluated under the test sandbox environment for the Disko Bay Southern Deepwater Channel indicate that environmental sensitivity sign-off is not granted (false) for the protected coastal bird sanctuary and marine mammal migration perimeter.
CEPO-ECOSIGN-WCV：In the production environment, assessments for the Uummannaq Sound Outer Fairway indicate that environmental sensitivity sign-off is not granted (false) across the protected coastal bird sanctuary and marine mammal migration perimeter.
CEPO-ECOSIGN-HVG：Evaluations in the production environment for the Vaigat Strait Western Passage confirm that environmental sensitivity sign-off is granted (true) across the protected coastal bird sanctuary and marine mammal migration perimeter, based on an active compliance waiver in the official gazette.

information_points.title: Oil spill containment readiness（BOOM）
information_points.content:
CEPO-BOOM-ZEJ：For the Vaigat Strait Western Passage, the rapid-deploy containment boom length ready at the corridor entrance emergency cache totals 1,200 m.
CEPO-BOOM-AB2：For the Disko Bay Southern Deepwater Channel, the rapid-deploy containment boom length staged at the corridor entrance emergency cache is 600 m of Arctic-grade floating oil containment boom ready for deployment.
CEPO-BOOM-92F：For the Uummannaq Sound Outer Fairway, the rapid-deploy containment boom length available at the corridor entrance emergency response cache is 900 m.
